title: Practice 2: Two verbs for every way of going

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Когда вы ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way) в Йорк?
exercises.why: **едете** — present tense (2nd person plural) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).
exercises.prompt: When are you going to York?

exercises.q: Вы все так разоделись. Куда ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way)?
exercises.why: **идёте** — present tense (2nd person plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: You're all dressed up. Where are you going?

exercises.q: Завтра Том ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way) в Ним.
exercises.why: **едет** — present tense (3rd person singular) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).
exercises.prompt: Tom is going to Nîmes tomorrow.

exercises.q: Мои дети ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way) в Кёльн.
exercises.why: **едут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).
exercises.prompt: My children are going to Cologne.

exercises.q: В мае он ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way) в Китай.
exercises.why: **едет** — present tense (3rd person singular) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).
exercises.prompt: He goes to China in May.

exercises.q: Они ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way) в Узбекистан.
exercises.why: **едут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).

exercises.q: Завтра они ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way) в Ним.
exercises.why: **едут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).
exercises.prompt: They are going to Nîmes tomorrow.

exercises.q: Я завтра ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way) в Турцию.
exercises.why: **еду** — present tense (1st person singular) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).

exercises.q: Завтра я ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way) в Шанхай.
exercises.why: **еду** — present tense (1st person singular) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).

exercises.q: Мелани ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way) в аэропорт.
exercises.why: **едет** — present tense (3rd person singular) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).
exercises.prompt: Melanie is going to the airport.

exercises.q: Вы ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way) на мясной рынок?
exercises.why: **едете** — present tense (2nd person plural) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).
exercises.prompt: Are you going to the meat market?

exercises.q: Место бойкое, торговля ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) отлично.
exercises.why: **идет** — present tense (3rd person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: The place is lively, and business is going well.

exercises.q: Синеватая птица ___ (лететь — to fly, one way) к высокому дереву.
exercises.why: **летит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of лететь: one-direction verb (many directions: летать).
exercises.prompt: A bluish bird is flying to the tall tree.

exercises.q: Этот автобус ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way) в Минск.
exercises.why: **едет** — present tense (3rd person singular) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).
exercises.prompt: This bus is going to Minsk.

exercises.q: Птицы ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general) в округе.
exercises.why: **летают** — present tense (3rd person plural) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).

exercises.q: Когда вы ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way) в Сан-Паулу?
exercises.why: **едете** — present tense (2nd person plural) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).
exercises.prompt: When are you going to São Paulo?

exercises.q: Орлы стаями не ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general).
exercises.why: **летают** — present tense (3rd person plural) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).

exercises.q: Некоторые рыбы ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general).
exercises.why: **летают** — present tense (3rd person plural) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).
